final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) as avg_spent, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(remaining) as global_avg_remaining FROM budget) SELECT step1.link_to_event, step1.avg_spent, step1.avg_remaining, step1.avg_remaining - step2.global_avg_remaining as diff FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.global_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
